references.title: Whale Watching Azores Islands
references.description:
Whale Watching in Azores Islands is unquestionably one of the most exciting adventures in Portugal! 15 minutes away from Ponta Delgada airport in São Miguel, and 2 to 3 hours from UK & EU, 4 - 5 from US & Canada! https://www.azoreswhalewatch.com

Join exciting Adventure Expeditions with TERRA AZUL, marine eco-tour operator since 2001, specialized in #WhaleWatching and Wildlife Tours, daily at the Marina of Vila Franca do Campo in São Miguel - #Azores Islands, heart of the Atlantic Ocean.

Responsible #Ecotourism with Scientific Education, Research Contribution, Wildlife Conservation, Local Culture - and the highest respect for Nature.

#Travel to a unique place to observe Marine Wildlife, with a 98% spotting chance for Cetaceans in average 3 different species per tour. 4 resident species (including Sperm Whales), and from March up to 24 species, with Blue #Whales, Fin Whales, Sei Whales, and many many #Dolphins, many Birds and abundant marine #Wildlife!

Subscribe for More Wildlife Videos! https://goo.gl/Drrq5a
See Whales & Dolphins - https://www.azoreswhalewatch.com

Many thanks to our media partners Altavisão produções for their amazing work!

references.title: I Went Whale Watching To Test The Hype
references.description:
Join me on an unforgettable adventure as I embark on a whale watching tour in Sydney to see if it's worth the hype! As we set off from Circular Quay, I'm excited to spot some of the incredible wildlife that calls our oceans home, including the majestic humpback whale. With Fantasea Cruises, we'll explore the stunning coastline and get up close and personal with these gentle giants. From the soothing ocean sounds to the breathtaking sights, this Sydney whale watching cruise is an experience like no other. But will it live up to the hype? 

Watch until the end to find out! If you're planning a trip to Sydney, be sure to add a whale watching tour to your list of must-do experiences. With deals and discounts available, it's an affordable and unforgettable way to connect with nature. So sit back, relax, and enjoy the ride!

 
Instagram : ernesthojilla

0:28 Fantasea Cruising
5:55 Where are the Whales?

Reference: 
You can book online. using the link below.
https://www.whalewatchingsydney.com.au/


#whalewatching #fantaseacruising  #Sydneywhalewatching
